rule_text: The candidate passes only if all conditions hold:
1. Net exact gain over frozen PP-OCRv5 is at least +50 cards on the full 618-card internal validation.
2. Newly exact > regressed exact, with a one-sided paired sign test p-value < 0.01.
3. Regressed baseline-exact cards do not exceed: min(25 cards, 5% of PP-OCRv5 baseline-exact cards).
4. Candidate short outputs = 0. Candidate empty outputs = 0. Candidate overlong outputs = 0.
5. No access failure, denominator change, label mismatch, privacy violation, or truth-dependent selection occurs.
6. Both systems are evaluated on the identical frozen 618-card population using the same truth normalization and exact-match contract.
Do not alter this rule after accessing the validation split.

sign_test.statistic: P(X >= newly_exact | n = newly_exact + regressed_exact, p = 0.5)

regression_cap.rounding: none; compared as a real number

identical_population.truth_normalization: phase2l_a.normalize_digits applied to the frozen Phase 2H lookup value
identical_population.exact_match: normalized prediction string == normalized 14-digit truth string
identical_population.digit_accuracy: positional: position k correct iff k < len(prediction) and prediction[k] == truth[k]; denominator 14 per card

decision_mapping.FIXED14_V2_VALIDATION_FAILED: no protocol violation, and any of conditions 1-4 fails, or condition 5 fails only through a genuine access or runtime failure
decision_mapping.PHASE2L_C_EVALUATION_INVALID: candidate or evaluator hash changes, population or denominator changes, label mismatch, privacy violation, truth-dependent selection, a condition-6 failure, or a second evaluation attempt

frozen_comparator.provenance: equals internal_validation.candidate_file_sha256 in tracked reports/phase2i_b_metrics.json (commit a9dd15e)
